name: smwmusic-pok-mon-ruby-sapphire-emerald-dive
title: Pokémon Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald - Dive
description:
This is the music that plays when you use the HM Dive in Pokemon Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald.

Obviously, it would probably fit water levels the best. XD

I couldn't quite get an accurate representation of the chimes using default samples, but @3 fills the role adequately.

I also did not include the section at the very end where bubbles would normally play as I have no idea how to do that without introducing samples. I considered using noise to mimic sea waves but I couldn't quite get it sounding right.

I feel like this project ended up quite good sounding though, and I'm proud of it. ^^
